conf.description: CrowdStrike Falcon detection-summary / json: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-integration).

conf.comment: crowdstrike-falcon / detection-summary / json. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic integration is the parser downstream (CrowdStrike integration, falcon data stream). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).
